tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. Text on it: foreground, muted-foreground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on background.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised panels, table headers, inset wells on surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers; structure comes from these, not boxes.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines, emphasised dividers (not a meaning-bearing mark: pair with a label).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, surface, surface-2.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary text on background and surface.

tokens.name: faint-foreground
tokens.usage: Captions and disabled text; large or non-essential only (can sit under 4.5:1 on surface-2).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour on any surface; 2px solid.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand/action colour per view: primary button fill, active tab underline, links.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind drawers and sheets.

tokens.name: measured
tokens.usage: Tier A / MEASURED / PHYSICS. Established or read off an instrument. Reserved: never a chart series or UI state. Always paired with a word and glyph (see Tier).

tokens.name: predicted
tokens.usage: Tier B / PREDICTED / MODELLED. Model output; always italic in values. Reserved: never a chart series or UI state. Always paired with a word and glyph (see Tier).

tokens.name: exploring
tokens.usage: Tier C / EXPLORATORY. Open, weak or contested. Reserved: never a chart series or UI state. Always paired with a word and glyph (see Tier).

tokens.name: spec
tokens.usage: SPEC / ADDED / TASTE. Speculative or invented; never evidence. Reserved: never a chart series or UI state. Always paired with a word and glyph (see Tier).

tokens.name: refuted
tokens.usage: REFUTED. A claim this project explicitly does not make. Reserved: never a chart series or UI state. Always paired with a word and glyph (see Tier).

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 1, assigned in fixed order, never cycled. Only slots 1-3 are safe for all-pairs forms (scatter, small multiples).

tokens.name: series-2

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Signal/action ink in audio views (Polarize theme): one dominant clay element per view. Fills, marks, large type; not small text on surface-2 (4.23:1).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Human annotation only: markers, note timestamps, citation anchors.

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: Machine state only: verified, transcribed, synced.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Page titles. Instrument Serif, regular case only, never uppercased.

styles.name: text-base
styles.usage: All running text. Inter is never bold and never tracked; hierarchy is size, face, colour, case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: ALL uppercase text is IBM Plex Mono: eyebrows, kickers, data captions, tier names.
